title: Kim Exhaustion for Even Orthogonal Groups
body_html:
Kim Exhaustion for Even Orthogonal Groups

Under the paper's large residue-characteristic hypotheses, every irreducible supercuspidal representation of \(G=O(V)\), with \(V\) even-dimensional, is \(\pi_\Sigma\) for some supercuspidal datum \(\Sigma\).
proof_html: Restrict an irreducible supercuspidal representation \(\pi\) of \(O(V)\) to \(SO(V)\), and choose an irreducible supercuspidal constituent. Kim's connected-group exhaustion writes that constituent as \({}^{\circ}\pi_{{}^{\circ}\Sigma}\). Lemma 3.9 extends the required depth character from the connected centralizer to \(G^0\). The Appendix A.2.2 construction supplies the corresponding \(K\)-module \(\kappa\). The multiplicity space \[ \operatorname{Hom}_{K_{0+}}(\kappa,\pi) \] contains the depth-zero piece coming from the connected datum; choosing an irreducible \(G_x^0\)-submodule \(\rho\) gives a datum \(\Sigma\). The representation \(\pi\) embeds in \(\pi_\Sigma\), and Theorem 3.10 makes \(\pi_\Sigma\) irreducible, so \(\pi=\pi_\Sigma\).
